artworks.title: Burning the Grasses (Le bruleur d'herbes)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a figure crouched at the base of a large tree trunk in a forest setting. The trees and foliage are dense, with no visible horizon. The detailed etching depicts the texture of the tree bark and light filtering through the trees. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of sepia or brown. Light and shadow highlight the figure and environment. The trees frame the scene and lead the eye upwards towards a softly lit area in the distance.

artworks.title: Study of a Spaniard (Etude d'Espagnol)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image is a detailed sketch of a person's upper torso and head. The individual is facing slightly to the right, looking upwards with a focused gaze. The person has distinct facial features, including pronounced eyebrows, deep-set eyes, a prominent mustache, and a pointed beard. Their wavy hair is swept back from the face. The person is wearing a collared garment, possibly a shirt, with fine striations or folds indicating texture. The background is neutral with some shading, creating contrast with the figure. The initials or signature "A. Legros" is in the bottom right corner of the work.

artworks.title: Desperate Young Girl (La jeune desesperee)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a person sitting with their head resting on one hand, which is supported by a bent arm. The person's facial features are not detailed, and their hair is covered with a draped cloth. They wear a garment with long sleeves. The background features large tree trunks and foliage. There are no visible objects or jewelry. The scene is depicted in a sketch-like style with cross-hatching for shading.

artworks.title: Alphonse Legros Sketching
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image depicts an elderly man sitting at a table, drawing on a large sheet of paper. He is wearing a hat, a coat, and a beard and mustache. Nearby are scattered papers and a chair with a patterned backrest. In the background, there are stacked items on the floor and a wall with the name "LEGROS" inscribed at the top left corner.

artworks.title: Head of a Man (Tete d'homme)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed sketch of a man's head and shoulders in profile view. He has a bearded face with deep-set eyes, a pronounced nose, and a strong jawline. His long hair flows down to below his shoulders. The man's upper body is bare, with shading and form depicted with hatching lines. The background is blank.

artworks.title: Landscape with Peat-bog; In the Marsh (Paysage des tourbieres; Dans les marais)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape created with delicate etching techniques. The horizon is high in the composition, with foliage and distant trees adding depth. The etchings form light, textured lines. The color palette is monochromatic, with a dominant sepia or beige tone. Dark vegetation creates a horizontal line in the foreground, while two figures are visible in the water, one holding a long stick.

artworks.title: Farmer and His Donkey (Le fermier et son ane)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a dense forest with tall, thin trees leaning slightly. The horizon is hidden by the trees and undergrowth. The painting technique uses expressive brushstrokes creating movement. The color palette is monochromatic with blacks and grays. A white horse is in the foreground.

artworks.title: Small Lake (Le petit lac)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image depicts a view from within a dense forest. The horizon is not visible, with trees extending upwards. The etching technique is used for detailed lines defining the trees and foliage. The color scheme is monochromatic, with shades of gray and black. The trees are intricately detailed, with some trees less distinct in the distance, suggesting a thick forest.

artworks.title: Farm on a Hill (La ferme sur la colline)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The landscape is viewed from a slightly elevated position, showing a scene that extends into the distance. The horizon is blended with foliage and the rooftop of a building obscured by trees. A structure, possibly a house or villa, is surrounded by lush vegetation in shades of dark and light browns and blacks. The artwork features fine etching techniques with cross-hatching for texture and depth, particularly in the foliage and shadows. Details of shrubs and ground foliage are visible in the shadows, while lines soften in the distance towards the building. The color palette is monochromatic, contrasting etched areas with lighter surfaces for visual impact.

artworks.title: Chailli Seen in a Storm (Chailli: Effet d'orage)
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on light green paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image is an etching of a rural landscape. The composition showcases the scene from a slightly elevated viewpoint, allowing a downward view. The horizon is positioned in the upper third, with tree tops extending slightly above it. The etching depicts a detailed rural landscape using cross-hatching and tightly woven strokes to create texture and depth. The color palette is monochrome, with shades of black and white enhancing the contrast of the lines. A structure with a thatched roof supported by poles is in the foreground, while dense trees occupy the background. The etching suggests movement in the sky, possibly indicating swirling clouds or a breeze.

artworks.title: Address of R. Gueraut (Adresse de M.R. Gueraut)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a scene with tall trees on the left and a wooden sign in focus, reading "R. GURAUT" with "Encadrements & Montures Artistiques" beneath it. Lines resembling grass or foliage are around the sign. The horizon is not visible, with the focus on the sign and surrounding nature. The etching technique features delicate lines and hatching for texture. The color palette is monochromatic in brownish-red tones on a creamy background. Lines in the image provide depth and guide the viewer's eye.

artworks.title: The Tinker (Le retameur)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: This drawing shows a person sitting outdoors cleaning a pot. The setting includes tall trees, lush foliage, and various pots and a kettle around the person. Some pots catch light to reveal textures and shadows. The person appears focused on cleaning one pot, with a steaming cauldron nearby. The artwork features detailed linework for the natural surroundings, the person's clothing, and hair.

artworks.title: The Tinker (Le retameur)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a man sitting in a crouched position, concentrating on an object in his hands. He has short hair, defined facial features, and is wearing a loose garment. In front of him are household items including a teapot, a large container, and a cloth or bag. The background includes foliage and a tree trunk. The drawing is done in delicate lines, giving it a soft and subdued atmosphere.

artworks.title: Sleeping Scholar (Le savant endormi)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image depicts a person seated at a table, leaning forward with their head resting on their left arm. They are wearing a loose garment with long sleeves. On the table, there is a sheet of paper or canvas, a dark bottle, and a few indistinct objects. In the background, there are obscured figures and shapes. The scene is created in a monochromatic sketch style with crosshatching for shadow and texture.

artworks.title: Choirmaster (Le maitre de chapelle)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image is an etching of an older man seated at a keyboard instrument, engrossed in reading sheet music. The man has distinguished features, including a pronounced nose and white beard. He has medium-length white hair and wears a dark garment. His right hand is on the keyboard touching the keys, while his left hand is following along with the music. The background is heavily cross-hatched, creating a textured and dim ambiance with little detail apart from the subject and the sheet music.

artworks.title: Alphonse Legros
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The sketch depicts a man's upper body in a side profile position. His head is slightly turned to the side, with his gaze forward. The man has an aged appearance with facial features like a prominent nose, full beard, mustache, and wavy shoulder-length hair. He is wearing a loose-fitting robe or overcoat, with visible sleeves. His hands are resting on his lap or the chair's armrest. There are no visible jewelry or additional objects, and the background is plain with subtle shading.

artworks.title: Interior of a Hut (Interieur de case)
artworks.creditLine: Rosenwald Collection
artworks.description: This is a monochromatic painting created through a printmaking technique, featuring abstract forms and textured patterns. The artwork shows a contrast between dark and light areas, with intricate textures resembling fabric or wood grain. The forms overlap each other.

artworks.title: The Last Supper
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Lewis Einstein
artworks.description: The image features a sketch of several people gathered in a large, ornate interior space. The sketch is drawn in a sepia tone, suggesting ink and wash on paper. The figures are shown from head to toe, with some seated, standing, or leaning forward. Their heads are mostly bald or have short hair, while their clothing resembles long robes or tunics. The people are gathered on either side of a central area, with architectural elements like arches and decorative patterns surrounding them. The background shows a detailed wall with relief artwork, including human and angelic figures.

artworks.title: Henry Laurens
artworks.artist: Valentine Green after John Singleton Copley
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William Robertson Coe
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated in an ornate chair. He rests one arm on a table with a document and a quill pen, while his other hand rests on the chair's armrest. The man has a bald head with tied-back hair, a serious expression, and prominent eyebrows. He wears a dark 18th-century suit with lace cuffs, knee-length breeches, and square-buckled shoes. A patterned carpet covers part of the table. In the background, architectural elements like drapery and a column are visible.

artworks.title: View across the Giudecca Canal toward the Salute and the Campanile of San Marco
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on blue wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Helen Haseltine Plowden
artworks.description: The image shows a view of Venice with buildings and boats lining the cityscape. A calm body of water occupies the foreground, with a gondola and a gondolier visible. Classic Venetian structures, including churches and a bell tower, create the skyline. The painting features soft brushstrokes, a color palette of gray, blue, and yellow, and a cloudless sky casting gentle light over the scene.

artworks.title: Blankenberge No.3
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gouache on blue wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Helen Haseltine Plowden
artworks.description: The image displays a beach with two boats on the shore, a group of people standing near them. The horizon is visible slightly above the center, with a strip of sea meeting a pale sky. A distant ship is faintly visible on the horizon. The color palette is composed of muted tones of brown, blue, and gray. The artwork features soft textures, possibly created with thin brushstrokes or watercolor techniques.

artworks.title: Between Rounds, large, first stone
artworks.creditLine: Andrew W. Mellon Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a man partly visible in a boxing ring corner, being attended to by two individuals. The man sits on a stool, leaning back on the ropes. His head is turned to the side and his face is not fully visible. He is shirtless with boxing shorts and shoes. One person is sponging him down, and another is holding a towel. There is a pipe in one person's hand. Another boxer is in the ring, also being attended to. A crowd of spectators fills the background. The setting appears to be indoors, with the ring well-lit and the crowd partly shadowed for contrast.

artworks.title: Between Rounds, small, second stone
artworks.creditLine: Andrew W. Mellon Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a boxing match in progress, focusing on a corner scene during a break. It depicts a boxer seated on a stool in one corner of the ring, surrounded by his support team. The boxer appears tired, with his head tilted back. One person is holding a bright light above, illuminating the scene. In the background, another boxer is resting in the opposite corner with their team. The audience below is dressed in period attire, including hats and trench coats, adding to the historical context of the scene.

artworks.title: Counted Out, first stone
artworks.creditLine: Andrew W. Mellon Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a boxing match conclusion. The drawing depicts a boxing ring where one boxer lies defeated on the ground while another boxer stands, possibly in victory. A referee is gesturing, potentially signaling the end of the match. The scene is filled with intensity, capturing the moment of decision in the boxing match. Spectators and possibly trainers lean against the ropes, intently following the outcome. Shadows and shading are used to give depth and drama to the composition.
